name: Equivalence Queries Complexity of Singletons
proof: For $n=1$, the target is known without a query. For $n\ge2$, query the all-zero labeling. Every singleton target disagrees with it only at its unique positive coordinate, so any counterexample identifies the target. Zero queries cannot distinguish the $n$ possible targets. This is a direct proof and does not require a general comparison with Littlestone dimension.
